instrument: Perpres 10/2021 as amended by 49/2021, Lampiran II, entry 46 (+ entry 47 for the mail-order/internet channel of the same goods)
population: SAETTA-20260915 W-H PR-3/PR-4 (folded): the 8 specialised-retail codes of the W-F dossier scope table (55201/55203/79903 scope line, §3.2, §6.1). Entry 46's heading is exactly "Perdagangan eceran:" with NO format/surface/place qualifier (lane-C §3A.2: 6 columns, no Persyaratan column) — the reservation is of the WHOLE 2025 code, per D5b (Zero, 2026-09-15 16:05 WITA, applied).
adjudicated: 2026-09-15, W-F dossier r2 §3.2 + §1.3(ii); refuter Codex GPT-5.6 sol xhigh F-09 concurs: 'the voce 46 nomina esattamente ciascun prodotto e il suo KBLI, quindi Pasal 5(5) non restringe nulla, perché il KBLI non copre più bidang usaha'. Astra independently read the same table (adjudication-source.json, AUTO-SAFE, source_reread=true, crosswalk 1:1 stesso numero).
why_not_the_existing_compiler: apply_umkm_reservations.py's `judged_as` gate refuses whenever a 2025 code's `bps_2020_ancestors` names any 2020 code OTHER than the one judged (the 'broader than the reserved activity' check) — correct for a code that absorbed an UNRELATED activity, but every one of these 8 codes also absorbs one or two 2020 mail-order/other-retail buckets (e.g. 47911, 47992) that BPS split across DOZENS of unrelated 2025 codes (verified: `heirs_of('47911')` has 22 heirs spanning alcohol/fuel/pharma/food retail — measured empirically in this session's probe, dry-run REFUSE on 47241 reproduced before writing this compiler). Lampiran II's entry 47 allocates the SAME goods sold by mail order/internet (dossier §3.2: 'Più p14 no 47 per la vendita per posta/internet dei medesimi beni'), so the extra ancestor is a CHANNEL variant of the same reserved product, not a different bidang usaha — but that is a judgment this spec states and a human can audit (`benign_shared_ancestors`), not a mechanical deduction the existing gate can make. 47245/47246 additionally split ONE 2020 ancestor (2020 code 47245, 'Daging dan ikan olahan' = processed meat AND fish combined) into TWO 2025 heirs that TOGETHER exhaust the named row — no third sibling is left open, unlike the barber-shop/hotel-grade split pattern in `umkm_lampiran_ii_split_heirs_2026_08_06.json` where only ONE sibling closes and the rest stay open.

generalist_retail_never_touched.why: Selling the same goods inside a supermarket or general store uses a different KBLI (4711x) and is not named by entry 46 (dossier §3.2).

generic_ancestors_never_treated_as_ident.why: Each fans into a dozen-plus unrelated 2025 codes (measured via heirs_of in this dataset) — a 2020 catch-all for mail-order/other retail across many product classes, split by BPS across many 2025 products. Present on every item as `benign_shared_ancestors`, never used as `self_ancestor`.
